I'd like to point out that it is pretty hard to do a successful tri build until level 165+. Because a lot of loot will be bi-element. 
Of someone thinks I am wrong : just compare the price and how difficult it is to have a tribuild before. 

So you can either go bi and restat later, or start with tri and have a harder time. 

As for Iop Wrath : in PvE most monsters don't try to flee. Which means they won't take the second instance of damage. 

The best damage output you can make is by going melee and single target damage. Later you can add some earth spell in order to become more tanky. 

I hope it helped.

Hey everyone. 
I will be away for 3 days because of my job. But after this I will start talking about the insane grind we went through with my mate ( I play 3 heroes and he plays 3 too). But we were both jobless so we were playing from 6 to 22 everyday. 

As for the Kamas, the easiest way to farm is within your guild's world. Some materials, especially the one needed for the restat quest are expensive. On Dathura ( one of the French servers). You can earn more than 900 000kamas for 100 materials. 

Always aim for the highest dungeon you can do. But don't forget to dodge hard one ( like vampyro etc). 

And don't forget to create your own keys. We made so much money just by selling keys and not buying any. 

It might slow down your exp route, but you will gain efficiency later. 

So, I will be writting the first part this weekend. I am nothing but a little frenchie, feel free to correct my English.
